sentences: Patient is a 65-year-old man with low back pain for about three months.
Denies bowel or bladder changes, fever, weight loss or any history of cancer.
Symptoms persist after more than two months of physical therapy and daily naproxen.
Plan: MRI of the lumbar spine without contrast.

payer_letter: Harborline Medicare Advantage has reviewed claim A-1035 for MRI of the lumbar spine. Coverage requires documentation of a prior lumbar spine X-ray together with at least six weeks of conservative treatment, or a red flag condition. The records submitted do not document a prior lumbar spine X-ray. You may request reconsideration within 60 days of this notice.
